items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: Ronald Bell, who was heavily influenced by John Coltrane

ctx.x: And that’s what it is. And by the way in their pre-Kool and the Gang life they were a jazz group. And so I was very influenced by them, particularly Ronald Bell, who was heavily influenced by John Coltrane. So the music to me is all this incredible tapestry with these different threads. Or we could think about it with an amazing tree with all of these branches. And it’s all music, it’s all a continuum. And I try not to so much in my own music, try not to say well we can’t allow ourselves to think this way because…

Yeah I believe so. And it seems like it’s an innovation in a sense when you’re bringing all those elements together because I’ve often wondered if it’s constantly getting harder for people to become innovators.
